source.caption: Sequence layout for VideoPoet. We encode all modalities into the discrete token space, so that we can directly use large language model architectures for video generation. We denote special tokens in $<>$ (see Table~\ref{tab:special_tokens} for definitions). The modality agnostic tokens are in darker red; the text related components are in blue; the vision related components are in yellow; the audio related components are in green. The left portion of the layout on light yellow represents the bidirectional prefix inputs. The right portion on darker red represents the autoregressively generated outputs with causal attention.
source.caption_tex:
\textbf{Sequence layout for \modelname{}}. We encode all modalities into the discrete token space, so that we can directly use large language model architectures for video generation.
    We denote special tokens in $<>$ (see Table~\ref{tab:special_tokens} for definitions).
    The modality agnostic tokens are in darker red; the text related components are in blue; the vision related components are in yellow; the audio related components are in green.
    The left portion of the layout on light yellow represents the bidirectional prefix inputs.
    The right portion on darker red represents the autoregressively generated outputs with causal attention.
